injection.scope: Two appended texts on four selected constructed fixtures. A verdict change alone does not prove instruction following: the added artifact text may itself affect substantive validity. No general prompt-injection robustness or security certification follows.

normalization.scope: Secondary reproduction of the frozen locator normalizer. It strips location prefixes and retains only the first verified nonempty segment of a multiline quote; this can weaken evidence coverage. Its apparent format recovery is not a semantic repair, accuracy result or human calibration.

cost.scope: All recorded physical requests in this phase, including separately reported recoveries. Original v0 responses reused without duplicate charges; unknown error charges remain unresolved. Not a reconciled invoice.

first_attempt.scope: New judge_robustness_10 request ledger only. Original v0 responses reused without duplicate charges. Nonfinite, negative, Boolean or missing amounts are not treated as known charges. Not a reconciled invoice.

additional_recovery.scope: New judge_robustness_10 request ledger only. Original v0 responses reused without duplicate charges. Nonfinite, negative, Boolean or missing amounts are not treated as known charges. Not a reconciled invoice.

recovery.scope: Post-hoc transport recovery of previously failed logical requests. Primary comparisons use archived first attempts; final logical-job coverage and all physical request costs are shown separately. Recovery is not a randomized intervention or evidence of improved grader accuracy.

first_attempt_provenance.validation: Snapshot and recovery-file hashes, original ledger prefix, request identities and predecessor metadata are checked. Source archive hash is additionally checked when the archive is present; the portable package uses the hashed snapshots.

limitations: All primary verdict comparisons require independently recomputed raw quote/coverage validity and the recorded automated-assessment status.
Invalid, missing, task-defective and uncertain results remain explicit; they are not silently counted as passes.
Quoted evidence can still fail to entail a judgment. No human agreement, error prevalence, model ranking or training improvement is established.
Prompt variants and constructed controls are dependent; counts describe this selected development sample.
